description: SPW-SG Secrétariat général: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SPW-SG Secrétariat général. Coverage: SPW-SG Secrétariat général. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Captages en eaux de surface en Wallonie (BE); Captages en eaux souterraines en Wallonie (BE); Zones de prévention et de surveillance autour des captages en Wallonie. Formats seen: GEOJSON, WMS, GMZ. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
